title: docs: fix the documented --detach-keys character list
body:
While looking at the --detach-keys help text I noticed the list of valid
ctrl-<value> characters doesn't match what actually gets parsed. moby/term
accepts @, a-z, [, \, ], ^ and _ (vendor/github.com/moby/term/ascii.go).
The man page that attach, exec, run and start all share leaves out \ and ],
and lists , which is really the separator rather than a value. run.go has
a-cf where it should say a-z, and run, start and attach all list ^ twice.
I left exec.go alone since #29275 is already fixing the same thing there.
It's only help text and docs so there's nothing to test, but the .go files
mean pr-should-include-tests will fail — could someone add the No New Tests
label?
